## option A

```{r}
library(limma)

R <- 100

power_vec <- numeric(R)
fdr_vec <- numeric(R)
n_disc_vec <- numeric(R)

for (r in 1:R) {
  set.seed(r)

  N <- 1000
  K <- 6
  n_diff <- 2
  beta_strength <- 2
  eps <- 1e-8

  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)
  mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

  diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
  diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
  diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, beta_strength, 0)

  eta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  }

  softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
  Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))

  pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
  n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

  log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
  for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
    k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
    k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
    log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log(Z[, k1] + eps) - log(Z[, k2] + eps)
  }

  pair_true <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    diff_k[idx[1]] != diff_k[idx[2]]
  })

  design <- model.matrix(~ X)
  fit <- lmFit(t(log_ratio_mat), design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")

  disc <- res$adj.P.Val < 0.05

  power_vec[r] <- mean(disc[pair_true])

  n_disc <- sum(disc)
  n_disc_vec[r] <- n_disc
  fdr_vec[r] <- if (n_disc == 0) 0 else sum(disc & !pair_true) / n_disc
}

cat("Mean power over", R, "sims =", round(mean(power_vec), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR over", R, "sims =", round(mean(fdr_vec), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean number of discoveries =", round(mean(n_disc_vec), 3), "\n")
```



```{r}
library(limma)
library(JuliaCall)

# -----------------------------
# Julia setup for EPB
# -----------------------------
julia_setup(JULIA_HOME = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env/pyjuliapkg/install/bin")
julia_command("import Pkg")
julia_command('Pkg.activate("/opt/anaconda3/julia_env")')
julia_command("using Empirikos, Hypatia, MultipleTesting")

run_epb_pairs <- function(beta_hat, se_hat, df_resid, alpha = 0.05) {
  beta_vec <- as.numeric(beta_hat)
  se2_vec  <- as.numeric(se_hat^2)
  nu_val   <- as.integer(df_resid[1])

  julia_assign("beta_vec_r", beta_vec)
  julia_assign("se2_vec_r", se2_vec)
  julia_assign("nu_val_r", nu_val)
  julia_assign("alpha_r", alpha)

  julia_command("
    samples_epb = [Empirikos.NormalChiSquareSample(beta_vec_r[i], se2_vec_r[i], nu_val_r)
                   for i in eachindex(beta_vec_r)]
  ")
  julia_command("
    test_epb_r = Empirikos.EmpiricalPartiallyBayesTTest(
      α = alpha_r,
      solver = Hypatia.Optimizer
    )
  ")
  julia_command("res_epb_r = fit(test_epb_r, samples_epb)")

  list(
    adjp   = as.numeric(julia_eval("res_epb_r.adjp")),
    rj_idx = as.logical(julia_eval("res_epb_r.rj_idx"))
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# simulation comparison
# -----------------------------
R <- 100

power_ord <- numeric(R)
fdr_ord   <- numeric(R)
ndisc_ord <- numeric(R)

power_limma <- numeric(R)
fdr_limma   <- numeric(R)
ndisc_limma <- numeric(R)

power_epb <- numeric(R)
fdr_epb   <- numeric(R)
ndisc_epb <- numeric(R)

for (r in 1:R) {
  set.seed(r)

  N <- 1000
  K <- 6
  n_diff <- 2
  beta_strength <- 2
  eps <- 1e-8

  # -----------------------------
  # simulate one dataset
  # -----------------------------
  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)
  mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

  diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
  diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
  diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

  # same effect size for all true topics
  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, beta_strength, 0)

  eta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  }

  softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
  Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))

  # -----------------------------
  # pairwise log-ratios
  # -----------------------------
  pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))
  n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

  log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
  colnames(log_ratio_mat) <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])
  })

  for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
    k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
    k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
    log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log(Z[, k1] + eps) - log(Z[, k2] + eps)
  }

  # pair truth: one true and one false = non-null
  pair_true <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    diff_k[idx[1]] != diff_k[idx[2]]
  })

  # -----------------------------
  # fit ordinary / limma
  # -----------------------------
  design <- model.matrix(~ X)
  fit0 <- lmFit(t(log_ratio_mat), design)

  coef_hat <- fit0$coefficients[, 2]
  se_hat   <- fit0$stdev.unscaled[, 2] * fit0$sigma

  # ordinary t-test
  t_ord <- coef_hat / se_hat
  p_ord <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_ord), df = fit0$df.residual)
  q_ord <- p.adjust(p_ord, method = "BH")
  disc_ord <- q_ord < 0.05

  # limma
  fit_eb <- eBayes(fit0)
  q_limma <- p.adjust(fit_eb$p.value[, 2], method = "BH")
  disc_limma <- q_limma < 0.05

  # EPB
  epb_res <- run_epb_pairs(
    beta_hat = coef_hat,
    se_hat   = se_hat,
    df_resid = fit0$df.residual,
    alpha    = 0.05
  )
  disc_epb <- epb_res$rj_idx

  # -----------------------------
  # metrics helper
  # -----------------------------
  get_metrics <- function(disc, truth) {
    power <- mean(disc[truth])
    n_disc <- sum(disc)
    fdr <- if (n_disc == 0) 0 else sum(disc & !truth) / n_disc
    c(power = power, fdr = fdr, n_disc = n_disc)
  }

  m_ord   <- get_metrics(disc_ord,   pair_true)
  m_limma <- get_metrics(disc_limma, pair_true)
  m_epb   <- get_metrics(disc_epb,   pair_true)

  power_ord[r] <- m_ord["power"]
  fdr_ord[r]   <- m_ord["fdr"]
  ndisc_ord[r] <- m_ord["n_disc"]

  power_limma[r] <- m_limma["power"]
  fdr_limma[r]   <- m_limma["fdr"]
  ndisc_limma[r] <- m_limma["n_disc"]

  power_epb[r] <- m_epb["power"]
  fdr_epb[r]   <- m_epb["fdr"]
  ndisc_epb[r] <- m_epb["n_disc"]
}

```
```{r}
cat("=== Ordinary t-test ===\n")
cat("Mean power =", round(mean(power_ord), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR =", round(mean(fdr_ord), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean number of discoveries =", round(mean(ndisc_ord), 3), "\n\n")

cat("=== limma ===\n")
cat("Mean power =", round(mean(power_limma), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR =", round(mean(fdr_limma), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean number of discoveries =", round(mean(ndisc_limma), 3), "\n\n")

cat("=== EPB ===\n")
cat("Mean power =", round(mean(power_epb), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR =", round(mean(fdr_epb), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean number of discoveries =", round(mean(ndisc_epb), 3), "\n")
```

## one simulation
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(limma)

set.seed(1)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Simulation settings
# -----------------------------
N <- 1000
K <- 6
n_diff <- 2
beta_strength <- 2
eps <- 1e-8

# -----------------------------
# 2. Condition
# -----------------------------
X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

cat("Number in control:", sum(X == 0), "\n")
cat("Number in treatment:", sum(X == 1), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# 3. True topic-level parameters
# -----------------------------
mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 0.5)

diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

# same effect size for all true topics
beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, beta_strength, 0)

truth_topic <- data.frame(
  topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  mu_k = round(mu_k, 3),
  beta_k = round(beta_k, 3),
  diff_k = diff_k
)

cat("\n=== True topic-level truth ===\n")
print(truth_topic, row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Generate latent logits
# -----------------------------
eta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = K)
for (k in 1:K) {
  eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
}
colnames(eta) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Softmax to get true topic proportions
# -----------------------------
softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))
colnames(Z) <- paste0("Topic", 1:K)

cat("\nCheck rows sum to 1:\n")
print(summary(rowSums(Z)))

# -----------------------------
# 6. Topic-level summaries
# -----------------------------
mean_eta0 <- colMeans(eta[X == 0, , drop = FALSE])
mean_eta1 <- colMeans(eta[X == 1, , drop = FALSE])

eta_topic <- data.frame(
  topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  eta_control = round(mean_eta0, 3),
  eta_treatment = round(mean_eta1, 3),
  eta_shift = round(mean_eta1 - mean_eta0, 3),
  beta_k = round(beta_k, 3),
  diff_k = diff_k
)

cat("\n=== Latent topic means by condition ===\n")
print(eta_topic, row.names = FALSE)

mean_Z0 <- colMeans(Z[X == 0, , drop = FALSE])
mean_Z1 <- colMeans(Z[X == 1, , drop = FALSE])

obs_topic <- data.frame(
  topic = paste0("Topic", 1:K),
  mean_control = round(mean_Z0, 4),
  mean_treatment = round(mean_Z1, 4),
  diff = round(mean_Z1 - mean_Z0, 4),
  beta_k = round(beta_k, 3),
  diff_k = diff_k
)

cat("\n=== Observed topic proportions by condition ===\n")
print(obs_topic, row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 7. Plot latent logits by condition
# -----------------------------
df_eta <- data.frame(
  sample = 1:N,
  condition = factor(X, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Treatment")),
  eta
)

df_eta_long <- melt(
  df_eta,
  id.vars = c("sample", "condition"),
  variable.name = "topic",
  value.name = "eta_value"
)

ggplot(df_eta_long, aes(x = condition, y = eta_value, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Latent topic logits by condition",
    y = expression(eta[nk])
    
  )

# -----------------------------
# 8. Plot topic proportions by condition
# -----------------------------
df_topic_plot <- data.frame(
  sample = 1:N,
  condition = factor(X, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Treatment")),
  Z
)

df_topic_long <- melt(
  df_topic_plot,
  id.vars = c("sample", "condition"),
  variable.name = "topic",
  value.name = "proportion"
)

ggplot(df_topic_long, aes(x = condition, y = proportion, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "True topic proportions by condition",
    y = "Topic proportion"
  )

# -----------------------------
# 9. Pairwise truth
# -----------------------------
pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))

pair_df <- data.frame(
  pair = apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2])),
  k1 = pair_mat[, 1],
  k2 = pair_mat[, 2]
)

pair_df$diff_k1 <- diff_k[pair_df$k1]
pair_df$diff_k2 <- diff_k[pair_df$k2]

# current simulation truth:
# one true and one false = non-null
pair_df$pair_true <- pair_df$diff_k1 != pair_df$diff_k2

pair_df$beta_k1 <- beta_k[pair_df$k1]
pair_df$beta_k2 <- beta_k[pair_df$k2]
pair_df$beta_diff <- pair_df$beta_k1 - pair_df$beta_k2

pair_df$obs_shift <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_df)), function(i) {
  k1 <- pair_df$k1[i]
  k2 <- pair_df$k2[i]
  lr <- log(Z[, k1] + eps) - log(Z[, k2] + eps)
  mean(lr[X == 1]) - mean(lr[X == 0])
})

pair_df$obs_shift <- round(pair_df$obs_shift, 3)

cat("\n=== Pairwise truth table ===\n")
print(
  pair_df[, c("pair", "diff_k1", "diff_k2", "pair_true", "beta_diff", "obs_shift")],
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# 10. Plot pairwise truth vs observed shift
# -----------------------------
ggplot(pair_df, aes(x = beta_diff, y = obs_shift, color = pair_true, label = pair)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.08, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "True pairwise effect vs observed log-ratio shift",
    x = "True beta difference",
    y = "Observed mean log-ratio shift"
  )

# -----------------------------
# 11. Fit one-run ordinary + limma
# -----------------------------
n_pairs <- nrow(pair_mat)

log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = n_pairs)
colnames(log_ratio_mat) <- pair_df$pair

for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
  k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
  k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
  log_ratio_mat[, p] <- log(Z[, k1] + eps) - log(Z[, k2] + eps)
}

design <- model.matrix(~ X)
fit0 <- lmFit(t(log_ratio_mat), design)

coef_hat <- fit0$coefficients[, 2]
se_hat <- fit0$stdev.unscaled[, 2] * fit0$sigma

# ordinary
t_ord <- coef_hat / se_hat
p_ord <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_ord), df = fit0$df.residual)
q_ord <- p.adjust(p_ord, method = "BH")
disc_ord <- q_ord < 0.05

# limma
fit_eb <- eBayes(fit0)
q_limma <- p.adjust(fit_eb$p.value[, 2], method = "BH")
disc_limma <- q_limma < 0.05

one_run_res <- data.frame(
  pair = pair_df$pair,
  pair_true = pair_df$pair_true,
  beta_diff = pair_df$beta_diff,
  obs_shift = pair_df$obs_shift,
  coef_hat = round(coef_hat, 3),
  se_hat = round(se_hat, 3),
  q_ord = signif(q_ord, 3),
  disc_ord = disc_ord,
  q_limma = signif(q_limma, 3),
  disc_limma = disc_limma
)

cat("\n=== One-run testing results ===\n")
print(one_run_res, row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 12. One pair in detail
# -----------------------------
k1 <- pair_mat[1, 1]
k2 <- pair_mat[1, 2]
pair_name <- paste0("T", k1, "_vs_T", k2)

lr12 <- log(Z[, k1] + eps) - log(Z[, k2] + eps)

df_pair12 <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(X, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Treatment")),
  log_ratio = lr12
)

cat("\n=== Detailed check for", pair_name, "===\n")
cat("diff_k1 =", diff_k[k1], "\n")
cat("diff_k2 =", diff_k[k2], "\n")
cat("pair_true =", diff_k[k1] != diff_k[k2], "\n")
cat("beta_1 =", beta_k[k1], "\n")
cat("beta_2 =", beta_k[k2], "\n")
cat("mean log-ratio in control =", round(mean(lr12[X == 0]), 3), "\n")
cat("mean log-ratio in treatment =", round(mean(lr12[X == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("observed shift =", round(mean(lr12[X == 1]) - mean(lr12[X == 0]), 3), "\n")

ggplot(df_pair12, aes(x = condition, y = log_ratio, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(pair_name, " log-ratio by condition"),
    y = paste0("log(T", k1, " / T", k2, ")")
  )
```
